CULTURE OF ODONTOGLOSSUMS

Odontoglossums grow in Andean habitat at elevations between 1,500 and 3,800 metres.

Modern hybrids can include warmer-growing relatives, so parentage matters.

Light - Filtered light is recommended and direct sun can burn leaves.

Temperature - Night temperatures of 10-13 C are described as ideal.

Watering - Compost should not dry completely and winter watering is reduced.

Fertiliser - A continuous weak nutrient supply is recommended.

Air movement - Constant fresh air movement is recommended.

Potting - Repot while new roots are emerging and avoid oversized pots.
